verdict.rationale: Codex CLI, IDE extension, and desktop app all support adding local/remote MCP servers via config (`[mcp_servers.<id>]` table, `codex mcp add`), authenticate, and inspect tools before use, letting Codex use third-party tools/data like docs, browser, or Figma. This is well documented as a client-side capability shared across Codex hosts. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of MCP server usage in practice beyond docs.
